privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.stats1: This site loads Umami only when deployed and analytics are configured. Analytics measure overall page usage and are not used to build cross-site profiles.
privacy.stats2: When the browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, this site won't request the analytics script. Analytics being unavailable never blocks content access.
privacy.comments: The guestbook is provided by Giscus and GitHub Discussions. Opening the guestbook connects to Giscus; publishing requires a GitHub login. Messages and account info are displayed and handled per GitHub's rules. Please don't submit sensitive personal info like emails or phone numbers.
privacy.scope: Analytics may process page views, referrers, browser and device types, and coarse country/region location. This site doesn't actively collect precise location and doesn't use analytics cookies or localStorage to store an analytics identity.
privacy.hosting: The site is hosted on Vercel, whose infrastructure may process network logs needed to serve requests under its own policy. Messages are stored by GitHub Discussions, and Giscus loads and publishes them here.
